  cat("Reading:", sample_name, "\n")

  x = om_obj[[1]], 
  y = om_obj[-1], 
  add.cell.ids = names(om_obj), # Adds donor names to cell barcodes
  project = "healthy_control"
)

In [18]:
# DoubletFinder on fat_!
om_filtered <- JoinLayers(om_filtered)
# Pre-processing for the tool
om_filtered <- NormalizeData(om_filtered)
om_filtered <- FindVariableFeatures(om_filtered)
om_filtered <- ScaleData(om_filtered)
om_filtered <- RunPCA(om_filtered)
om_filtered <- RunUMAP(om_filtered, dims = 1:20)


# Find pK (Optimal neighborhood size)
sweep.res <- paramSweep(om_filtered, PCs = 1:20, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)
best.pk <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

# Predict Doublets
# Adjust 0.04 (4%) based on your expected doublet rate (approx 0.8% per 1000 cells)
nExp_poi <- round(0.126 * nrow(om_filtered@meta.data))  # We choose this percentage because we have more than 20,000 cells

om_filtered <- doubletFinder(om_filtered, PCs = 1:20, pN = 0.25, pK = best.pk, nExp = nExp_poi, sct = FALSE)

# Extract the column name (it changes based on parameters)
classification_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(om_filtered@meta.data), value = TRUE)

# CREATE THE FINAL SINGLET OBJECT
om_singlets <- subset(om_filtered, cells = rownames(om_filtered@meta.data)[om_filtered@meta.data[, classification_col] == "Singlet"])

# DoubletFinder on fat_!
subcut_filtered <- JoinLayers(subcut_filtered)

# Pre-processing for the tool
subcut_filtered <- NormalizeData(subcut_filtered)
subcut_filtered <- FindVariableFeatures(subcut_filtered)
subcut_filtered <- ScaleData(subcut_filtered)
subcut_filtered <- RunPCA(subcut_filtered)
subcut_filtered <- RunUMAP(subcut_filtered, dims = 1:20)


# Find pK (Optimal neighborhood size)
sweep.res <- paramSweep(subcut_filtered, PCs = 1:20, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)
best.pk <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

# Predict Doublets
# Adjust 0.04 (4%) based on your expected doublet rate (approx 0.8% per 1000 cells)
nExp_poi <- round(0.105 * nrow(subcut_filtered@meta.data))  # We choose this percentage because we have more than 20,000 cells

subcut_filtered <- doubletFinder(subcut_filtered, PCs = 1:20, pN = 0.25, pK = best.pk, nExp = nExp_poi, sct = FALSE)

# Extract the column name (it changes based on parameters)
classification_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(subcut_filtered@meta.data), value = TRUE)

# CREATE THE FINAL SINGLET OBJECT
sub_control_singlets <- subset(subcut_filtered, cells = rownames(subcut_filtered@meta.data)[subcut_filtered@meta.data[, classification_col] == "Singlet"])
